facts.fact: The FY2026 draft budget (medium-term expenditure framework) proposes FCFA 118 million, financed domestically, under the digital ministry's section to pay six months of 2024 salary arrears of the ACDD, the state's digital development agency; proposed, not yet passed in this document.
